annotation.title_clean: The Guideline for Japanese Governments' procurements and utilizations of generative AI for the sake of evolution and innovation of public administration (Abstract, Provisional Translation)
annotation.title_en: The Guideline for Japanese Governments' procurements and utilizations of generative AI for the sake of evolution and innovation of public administration (Abstract, Provisional Translation)
annotation.summary_en: English abstract of Japan's Digital Agency guideline (May 2025) on government procurement and use of text-generative AI. It sets up Chief AI Officers, an advisory board and consultation desk, risk-based identification of high-risk projects, procurement and contract check sheets, and a model user rule for staff. It has no embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Each ministry or agency appoints a Chief AI Officer to oversee generative AI use and risk management
Advanced AI Utilization Advisory Board and AI Consultation Desk advise on high-risk projects
High-risk AI Project Finder uses four axes: user scope, operation characteristics, confidential or personal data, and human judgment of outputs
Procurement and Contract Check Sheets cover governance, development, operation and system requirements such as bias, security and accountability
Model User's Rule restricts inputting classified data and requires verification of outputs and reporting of risk cases
